name: Memphis
overview: Memphis, also known as Noph, was a prominent and celebrated city in ancient Egypt, frequently mentioned in prophetic Scripture. The prophets Isaiah, Jeremiah, Ezekiel, and Hosea describe Memphis as a center of political power and influence that ultimately faces judgment and desolation due to its rebellion and failure to trust in God. These passages reveal that Memphis will experience distress, captivity, and devastation, symbolizing the broader downfall of Egypt under divine judgment.
